name: General Learning & Research
goal: Explore evidence, connect ideas, and develop useful learning or research questions.

ui.heading: Explore knowledge. Build understanding.
ui.introduction: Make human knowledge accessible to everyone, from the first lesson to the frontiers of scientific discovery.
ui.search_placeholder: What would you like to understand?
ui.welcome_text: Explore a topic, collect documents, practice with quizzes, and connect evidence to your own ideas. Live source coverage currently focuses on biomedical literature and genomics; use local documents and datasets for other subjects.
ui.guidance_text: Describe your goal, review a source, and write down what you still want to understand.
ui.deadline_hint: When would you like to complete your goal?
ui.data_hint: Documents, datasets, or tools you can use
ui.tip_text: Separate what the evidence establishes from your interpretation. Keep a source reference with each useful idea.
